candidates.alternative_paths: The ordinary compile-options mask does not set context extra options. Automatic callouts and match-time callout configuration do not exercise rejection of an explicit callout under PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT. The pcre2test and pcre2grep routes are separate executables.

before.requirement: No PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT rejection branch existed; compiling an explicit (?C) callout did not require enabling that option.
before.reason: The before parser handles explicit callouts without the new option check.

source_evidence.quote:
#define PUBLIC_COMPILE_EXTRA_OPTIONS \

    PCRE2_EXTRA_ALLOW_SURROGATE_ESCAPES|PCRE2_EXTRA_BAD_ESCAPE_IS_LITERAL| \
    PCRE2_EXTRA_ESCAPED_CR_IS_LF|PCRE2_EXTRA_ALT_BSUX| \
    PCRE2_EXTRA_ALLOW_LOOKAROUND_BSK|PCRE2_EXTRA_ASCII_BSD| \
    PCRE2_EXTRA_ASCII_BSS|PCRE2_EXTRA_ASCII_BSW|PCRE2_EXTRA_ASCII_POSIX| \
    PCRE2_EXTRA_ASCII_DIGIT|PCRE2_EXTRA_PYTHON_OCTAL|PCRE2_EXTRA_NO_BS0)

after.requirement: Set PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT on the compile context and compile a pattern containing an explicit (?C) callout to exercise ERR103.
after.reason: The parser reads extra options from the compile context and rejects the explicit callout only when the new bit is set. The fixed harness creates and passes a default context without setting compile extra options.

source_evidence.quote: uint32_t xoptions = cb->cx->extra_options;

claims.reason: The option-gated rejection was introduced after the before version. The harness's lack of a compile-extra-options setter blocks the after requirement; there was no corresponding before requirement.
